hsts.title: Missing HSTS Header
hsts.fix: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to force HTTPS and prevent SSL stripping.
hsts.code: app.use(helmet.hsts({ maxAge: 31536000, includeSubDomains: true, preload: true }));

csp.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
csp.fix: Implement a CSP to mitigate XSS and data injection attacks by restricting resource loading.

xframe.title: X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking)
xframe.fix: Protect against clickjacking by preventing your site from being rendered in a frame/iframe.

nosniff.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
nosniff.fix: Prevent the browser from MIME-sniffing the response away from the declared content-type.

referrer.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
referrer.fix: Control how much referrer information is included with requests.

sql_injection.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
sql_injection.fix: Always use parameterized queries or an ORM like Mongoose/Sequelize to avoid direct string concatenation in queries.
sql_injection.code:
// Bad: User.find({ name: req.body.name })
// Good: User.find({ name: { $eq: req.body.name } }) // Mongoose auto-escapes

cls.title: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
cls.fix: Reserve space for images and ads by providing explicit width/height attributes or using CSS aspect-ratio.

contrast.title: Low Color Contrast
contrast.fix: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 ratio) to improve legibility for all users.
contrast.code:
/* Use accessible color pairings */
.text-main { color: #1a1a1a; background: #ffffff; }

tap_targets.title: Small Tap Targets
tap_targets.fix: Interactive elements should be at least 48x48px with 8px spacing for mobile usability.

responsive.title: Non-Responsive Layout
responsive.fix: Use a flexible grid and media queries to ensure the site works on all screen sizes.

images.title: Unoptimized Images
images.fix: Use modern formats like WebP or Avif and implement lazy loading.

render_blocking.title: Render-Blocking Resources
render_blocking.fix: Defer non-critical JavaScript and use 'async' for scripts that don't need the DOM immediately.

caching.title: Missing Cache-Control Headers
caching.fix: Implement long-term caching for static assets to reduce server load and improve repeat visits.

404.title: Broken Link Discovery
404.fix: Fix broken links by updating the target URL or implementing 301 redirects.
